g.title: PST_F1
g.text: Bosch PST-F1 (order# 0261.544.01F / OEM equiv 0281006414). 5-pin Bosch Trapezoid connector. Pin 1 = NC (empty in housing). Active pins: 2=Pressure, 3=+5V, 4=GND, 5=Temp. Mating connector kit: Bosch F02U.B00.751-01 (housing 1928405159, 5-pin Trapez). ⚠️ NOT a 4-pin connector — ordering a 4-pin body will mismatch the sensor physically. Source: Bosch Motorsport datasheet bosch-motorsport.com PST-F 1 (Pin 2=Pressure Signal, Pin 3=Power Supply, Pin 4=Ground, Pin 5=Temperature Signal). Confirmed xtramotorsport.com. Pressure output: 0.5V = 0 bar, 4.5V = 10 bar (ratiometric, 5V supply). Temp output: NTC — calibrate in MTune against resistance table. Mount adapter: M14x1.5 female → M10x1.0 male. Phase 3: moves to 07K iABED oil housing (M10x1.0 port) unchanged.

g.title: W_PST_F1
g.text: Engine-bay run from PST-F1 sensor to M50 harness 16-pin aux breakout (both engine-bay side under the H2O arch — no firewall crossing). Keep away from ignition/coil wires.

g.title: ECU_16PIN
g.text: MaxxECU M50 terminated harness — 16-pin aux breakout
